fallback.text: The gain of a moving-average filter of N = 8 samples at a sampling rate of 8 kHz: close to 0 dB at low frequencies, about −1.3 dB at 300 Hz, and exact zeros (no output at all) at every multiple of fs/N = 1 kHz. A longer window smooths more and lowers the −3 dB frequency; a first-order (RC-like) filter has no zeros but falls by 20 dB per decade above its cutoff.
